description:
Prove Speechmatics works from the Even WebView before building on it (same shape as the phase0 Soniox spike, spikes/phase0-probe/src/spikes/soniox.ts, results under spikes/phase0-probe/results).

Check on Android + iOS Even app and the simulator:
1. POST https://mp.speechmatics.com/v1/api_keys?type=rt (and ?type=batch) with the user's key from the WebView: CORS allowed? Whitelist entry needed in app.json.
2. wss://<region>.rt.speechmatics.com/v2?jwt=... connects with the app.json network whitelist; which region hosts to whitelist (eu/us; pick default + setting?).
3. Stream G2 PCM (16 kHz s16le) with diarization "speaker", enable_partials, a low max_delay: first-partial and final latency vs Soniox on the same clip.
4. Realtime speaker ID round trip: session A with get_speakers -> SpeakersResult identifiers; session B with speakers [{label: <opaque person id>, speaker_identifiers}] -> AddTranscript carries that label. Note how soon in an utterance the enrolled label appears (drives live glasses naming) and how speakers_sensitivity changes it.
5. Batch: POST jobs to asr.api.speechmatics.com with a WAV from RecordingAudio, CORS, polling, get_speakers in batch; are batch identifiers usable in realtime on the same model?
6. Can identifiers be minted from a short enrollment clip over batch (for re-enrolling from kept voice clips)?

Record results + chosen endpoints/models in the spike results and a comment here. Stop the epic if 1 or 2 fail without a workaround.
title: Spike: Speechmatics realtime, batch and speaker ID from the Even WebView
